overview.zh: 9月HR行业聚焦AI技术深度融合与新规落地：人社部发布『人工智能＋人社』实施意见，9月1日劳动法新规生效，金九银十招聘季呈现岗位结构性调整，AI面试与智能筛选成为主流。
overview.en: September HR focuses on deep AI integration and new regulations: Ministry issued 'AI + Human Resources' guidelines, new labor laws effective Sept 1st, peak hiring season shows structural job shifts, AI interviews and intelligent screening become mainstream.

text.zh: 技术的进步不是为了替代人，而是让人做更有价值的事。
text.en: Technology advances not to replace people, but to let them do more valuable things.

title.zh: 9月1日新规落地：AI顶岗与社保合规成HR重点
title.en: New Labor Rules Effective Sept 1: AI Job Replacement and Social Security Compliance

summary.zh: 2026年9月1日起新劳动法规生效，明确AI替代岗位的用工责任与社保缴纳义务，HR需重新审视岗位设计与合规风险，避免因AI顶岗导致的社保弃缴违规。
summary.en: New labor regulations effective Sept 1, 2026 clarify employer responsibilities for AI-replaced positions and mandatory social security contributions. HR must reassess job design and compliance risks to avoid violations from AI workforce transitions.

title.zh: 人社部发布『人工智能＋人社』应用发展实施意见
title.en: Ministry Issues Implementation Guidelines for 'AI + Human Resources and Social Security'

summary.zh: 人力资源社会保障部联合国家发改委、工信部、国家数据局发布实施意见，推动AI在招聘、培训、薪酬管理、社保服务等场景的应用标准化与数据安全规范。
summary.en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, together with NDRC, MIIT, and National Data Administration, issued guidelines to standardize AI applications in recruitment, training, compensation management, and social security services with data security protocols.

title.zh: 全国首个『AI+人力资源服务』创新大赛在苏州举行
title.en: China's First 'AI + HR Services' Innovation Competition Held in Suzhou

summary.zh: 苏州举办全国首个AI人力资源服务创新创意大赛，展示智能面试、人才画像、组织效能分析等前沿应用，推动HR科技产业化落地。
summary.en: Suzhou hosted the nation's first AI HR services innovation competition, showcasing cutting-edge applications including intelligent interviews, talent profiling, and organizational effectiveness analysis to accelerate HR tech commercialization.

title.zh: 三分之二HR领导者愿意信任AI主导面试
title.en: Two-Thirds of HR Leaders Would Trust AI to Conduct Job Interviews

summary.zh: 最新研究显示，66%的HR领导者表示愿意让AI系统独立完成初步面试筛选，认为AI能减少偏见、提高效率，但仍需人工参与最终决策环节。
summary.en: Recent study shows 66% of HR leaders are willing to let AI systems independently conduct preliminary interview screening, believing AI reduces bias and improves efficiency, though human involvement remains essential for final decisions.

title.zh: 金九银十求职季：AI时代岗位分化加剧
title.en: September Hiring Peak: AI Era Accelerates Job Market Polarization

summary.zh: 9月招聘旺季数据显示，AI相关技能岗位薪酬上涨15-25%，传统行政、数据录入类岗位需求下降30%，HR需关注员工技能转型与内部流动机制建设。
summary.en: September hiring data reveals 15-25% salary increases for AI-skilled positions, while traditional administrative and data entry roles see 30% demand decline. HR must focus on employee reskilling and internal mobility mechanisms.

content.zh: AI驱动的人力资源管理不是简单的工具叠加，而是系统性重构。核心在于从『流程自动化』转向『决策智能化』：传统HRIS侧重事务性流程（考勤、薪酬计算），而AI HR需整合多源数据（绩效、行为、市场），通过预测模型支持战略决策（离职风险预警、继任者规划、组织健康度诊断）。关键是建立数据治理体系与算法透明度机制，避免『黑箱决策』引发合规与信任风险。
content.en: AI-driven HR management is not tool stacking but systemic reconstruction. The core shift is from 'process automation' to 'decision intelligence': traditional HRIS focuses on transactional workflows (attendance, payroll), while AI HR integrates multi-source data (performance, behavior, market) through predictive models to support strategic decisions (turnover risk alerts, succession planning, organizational health diagnostics). The key is establishing data governance and algorithmic transparency to avoid 'black box decisions' that trigger compliance and trust risks.

content.zh: 9月1日生效的新劳动法规明确了『算法用工』的法律边界：当AI系统实质性参与工作分配、绩效评估、解雇决策时，雇主需确保算法的可解释性、人工复核机制、员工申诉渠道三要素。这意味着HR不能完全依赖AI输出结果，必须保留人工最终审核权，并建立算法审计流程。对于AI替代的岗位，企业仍需按原编制承担社保义务，不能以『无人岗位』为由规避缴纳。
content.en: New labor regulations effective Sept 1 define legal boundaries for 'algorithmic employment': when AI systems substantially participate in work allocation, performance evaluation, or termination decisions, employers must ensure three elements—algorithm explainability, human review mechanisms, and employee appeal channels. This means HR cannot fully rely on AI outputs and must retain final human review authority with algorithm audit processes. For AI-replaced positions, companies must maintain social security obligations per original staffing and cannot evade contributions by claiming 'unmanned positions'.

content.zh: 金九银十招聘季的岗位结构性变化反映了技能贬值加速：AI工具的普及使部分岗位的『技能半衰期』从5年缩短至18个月。HR应对策略需从『招聘导向』转向『能力建设导向』：建立内部技能市场（skill marketplace）、推行微认证体系（micro-credentials）、设计『学习即工作』的项目制组织，让员工在实际项目中习得新技能。同时薪酬体系需从『岗位定价』转向『技能定价』，激励持续学习行为。
content.en: Structural job changes in the September hiring peak reflect accelerated skill depreciation: AI tool proliferation reduces the 'skill half-life' of certain roles from 5 years to 18 months. HR response strategies must shift from 'hiring-oriented' to 'capability-building-oriented': establish internal skill marketplaces, implement micro-credential systems, design 'learning-as-working' project-based organizations where employees acquire new skills through actual projects. Compensation systems must shift from 'job-based pricing' to 'skill-based pricing' to incentivize continuous learning.

content.zh: 【合规自查】今日启动9月1日新规合规检查：①列出所有使用AI系统参与的招聘、绩效、调岗决策流程；②核查每个流程是否有书面的人工复核机制与记录留存；③检查AI替代岗位的社保缴纳是否按原编制执行；④起草算法决策申诉处理SOP，明确员工质疑AI决策的渠道与响应时限。本周五前完成自查报告并提交管理层。
content.en: 【Compliance Audit】Launch Sept 1 regulation compliance check today: ①List all recruitment, performance, and transfer decision processes involving AI systems; ②Verify each process has documented human review mechanisms and record retention; ③Check if social security contributions for AI-replaced positions follow original staffing levels; ④Draft algorithm decision appeal SOP clarifying channels and response timelines for employees questioning AI decisions. Complete audit report and submit to management by Friday.

content.zh: 【技能盘点】金九银十期间开展组织技能地图更新：①与各部门负责人访谈，识别因AI工具普及而贬值的技能（如基础数据分析、文档编写）与新兴高价值技能（如提示工程、AI工具整合）；②用技能矩阵标注每位员工当前技能与目标岗位技能缺口；③优先为技能贬值风险高的员工（如行政、初级数据岗）设计3个月转型学习路径，本月内完成50人试点。
content.en: 【Skill Inventory】Update organizational skill map during peak hiring season: ①Interview department heads to identify skills depreciated by AI tools (e.g., basic data analysis, document writing) and emerging high-value skills (e.g., prompt engineering, AI tool integration); ②Use skill matrix to mark each employee's current skills and target role skill gaps; ③Prioritize designing 3-month transformation learning paths for high-risk employees (e.g., administrative, junior data roles), complete 50-person pilot this month.

content.zh: 【供应商评估】针对现有AI招聘与绩效管理系统进行算法透明度审查：①要求供应商提供算法逻辑说明文档与偏见测试报告；②测试『可解释性』功能（系统能否输出每个候选人/员工的评分依据）；③若现有系统不满足新规要求，启动替代方案调研，重点关注支持人工复核与审计日志的产品。下周三前完成评估并决定是否需要系统升级或更换。
content.en: 【Vendor Assessment】Conduct algorithm transparency review of existing AI recruitment and performance management systems: ①Request vendors provide algorithm logic documentation and bias testing reports; ②Test 'explainability' features (can system output scoring rationale for each candidate/employee); ③If current systems don't meet new regulations, initiate alternative solution research focusing on products supporting human review and audit logs. Complete assessment by next Wednesday and decide if system upgrade or replacement is needed.
